_readme: Mode profile for DIRECT mode: a visitor talks to Panganiban; the Host delivers one pre-rendered intro line, then stays silent with idle listening motion. Two variants, selected as the profile: `kiosk` (direct-kiosk: wake word ON, a question starts with 'Hi Cee-Jap', follow-up window open) and `event` (direct-event: wake word OFF — the open mic is the visitor's handheld transmitter, any sustained speech on it starts a question; louder room threshold; zero post-answer window). Values here are the base of the resolution order: mode profile -> systemd drop-in -> app/.env -> console override. Keep secrets out of this file. Keys under `profiles` override `defaults`. Setting -> robot env mapping lives in dashboard/console.py (SETTINGS).
host_intro_text: Good day. I am your host for today. Chief Justice Panganiban will take your questions — say 'Hi Cee-Jap' to begin.

kiosk._note: direct-kiosk: museum floor, self-service. Wake word on. Same values as the 2026-09-02 drop-in so behaviour is unchanged on first deploy.

event._note: direct-event: emcee-driven hall. Wake word OFF => the open mic (the handheld transmitter) gates the question: sustained speech above the loudness setting starts a capture. Higher loudness so a crowd does not hold the mic open (today's journal: room 923-1087 RMS). Zero post-answer window: back to the armed state right after each answer.

host_behaviour.intro: one pre-rendered intro line when direct mode starts (variants rotate; see data/prerendered/intro/)
host_behaviour.then: silent, idle listening motion, mic follows the floor lease
